achievements.name: Starship Mario
achievements.detail: Set off from Starship Mario toward the first galaxy on the map.

achievements.name: Sky Station
achievements.detail: Collect the first Power Star at the end of Sky Station Galaxy.

achievements.name: Saddle Up
achievements.detail: Free Yoshi from his egg and ride him in Yoshi Star Galaxy.

achievements.name: Cloud Mario
achievements.detail: Touch a Cloud Flower and create a cloud platform under your feet.

achievements.name: Rock Mario
achievements.detail: Grab a Rock Mushroom and roll through a galaxy as Rock Mario.

achievements.name: Hungry Luma
achievements.detail: Feed Star Bits to a Hungry Luma until a new galaxy appears.

achievements.name: Prankster Comet
achievements.detail: Complete a Prankster Comet challenge and collect its Power Star.

achievements.name: Comet Medal
achievements.detail: Find a Comet Medal hidden in a galaxy.

achievements.name: Grand Star
achievements.detail: Defeat a fortress boss and claim the Grand Star that opens the next world.

achievements.name: Green Star
achievements.detail: Pick up a Green Star after every ordinary Power Star has been collected.

achievements.name: Galaxy Generator
achievements.detail: Defeat Bowser inside Bowser's Galaxy Generator and rescue Peach.

achievements.name: Perfect Run
achievements.detail: Finish Grandmaster Galaxy's hardest comet without taking a hit.
